name: smwgraphics-doremi-fantasy-milon-no-dokidoki-daibouken-cake-world
title: DoReMi Fantasy: Milon no Dokidoki Daibouken - Cake World
description:
Almost all of the graphics from World 2 of the obscure platformer. The only thing missing is the 1/3 slope (along with related graphics), since it won't work in SMW.

Also, if you want to use the direct drop off slope (tiles 0A/1A and 0D/1D), you're going to have to use the Slope Edge Fix block. (or put a invisible solid block sprite below it)
